title: Architecture Spec
description: An architecture spec (ARCH): a cross-cutting technical rule on code style, structure, testing, or security. Applies repo-wide.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the spec.

description.description: Optional narrative: rationale for the rule and what it protects against.

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifiable acceptance criteria, provable by automated checks or AI. Each criteria starts with a commitment level.
